entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The thrum of the helicopter engine,..."
entries.dialogueText: The thrum of the helicopter engine, the first of its kind in Sordland, was deafening as we touched down on the landing pad of Antel Rock Prison.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stepped out, bracing myself again..."
entries.dialogueText: I stepped out, bracing myself against the salty winds. The noise of the helicopter was replaced by that of squawking seabirds and waves furiously crashing on the jagged rocks below.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Flanked by my guards, I walked into..."
entries.dialogueText: Flanked by my guards, I walked into Antel Rock Prison.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A team of security personnel led me..."
entries.dialogueText: A team of security personnel led me through the winding corridors on the ground floor.

entries.dialogueText: At the back of the building, we came to an elevator. The guards punched in a code, and we rode all the way to the top floor of the prison.

entries.dialogueText: And Kesaro Kibener...

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Passing by the rows of cells, I wondered how Frens Ricter was doing.

entries.dialogueText: Passing by the rows of cells, I wondered how Kesaro Kibener was doing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But that wasn't who I was here to s..."
entries.dialogueText: But that wasn't who I was here to see.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Passing by the rows of cells, I hea..."
entries.dialogueText: Passing by the rows of cells, I heard prisoners pounding on their doors and pleading me for a pardon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas had a corner cell, with larg..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas had a corner cell, with large windows overlooking the seaside. It was equipped with a comfortable-looking bed and a modest writing desk.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She appeared to be busy writing let..."
entries.dialogueText: She appeared to be busy writing letters as the guards opened the door to the room.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Hello, Lileas.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hello, Lileas."
entries.menuText: "Hello, Lileas."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who are you writing to?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who are you writing to?"
entries.menuText: "Who are you writing to?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Stop writing at once and speak to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stop writing at once and speak to me."
entries.menuText: "Stop writing at once and speak to me."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Mr. President. What brings you all..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. What brings you all this way?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Just catching up with a few old fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just catching up with a few old friends."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""What brings you all this way, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "What brings you all this way, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""No need for the imperatives. You a..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need for the imperatives. You already have me in a prison cell."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Why did you kill Bernard Circas?""
entries.dialogueText: "Why did you kill Bernard Circas?"
entries.menuText: "Why did you kill Bernard Circas?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You spent my entire term trying to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You spent my entire term trying to undermine me. Why?"
entries.menuText: "You spent my entire term trying to undermine me. Why?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who was really behind the Circas a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who was really behind the Circas assassination?"
entries.menuText: "Who was really behind the Circas assassination?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I thought you already knew the ans..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you already knew the answer to that."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I and my colleagues judged you to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I and my colleagues judged you to be a threat to Sordland. From the start of your term, we felt you were putting the country at risk of succumbing to outside influence."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas blinked and smiled benignly."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas blinked and smiled benignly.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I thought the court already establ..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought the court already established that during my trial. I drafted the order to the Young Sords, Hawker signed off on it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But whose idea was it, really?""
entries.dialogueText: "But whose idea was it, really?"
entries.menuText: "But whose idea was it, really?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Come off it, Lileas. How long have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come off it, Lileas. How long have you been Soll's puppet?"
entries.menuText: "Come off it, Lileas. How long have you been Soll's puppet?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I know what you're implying.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know what you're implying."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas drew herself up, her back st..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas drew herself up, her back straight as a rod.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Tarquin Soll was a great man with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tarquin Soll was a great man with whom I shared many ideals."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Tarquin Soll was -- is -- a great..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tarquin Soll was -- is -- a great man, with whom I share many ideals."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""But my decisions have always been..."
entries.dialogueText: "But my decisions have always been my own."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Obviously, we were right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Obviously, we were right."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Without our interference, who know..."
entries.dialogueText: "Without our interference, who knows what kind of radical change you would have brought."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Sordish people wanted change...."
entries.dialogueText: "The Sordish people wanted change. You can't just disregard their will."
entries.menuText: "The Sordish people wanted change. You can't just disregard their will."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm the President, and I wanted ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm the President, and I wanted change. You can't just disregard my will."
entries.menuText: "I'm the President, and I wanted change. You can't just disregard my will."

entries.dialogueText: "The President doesn't always know best."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""As shown by their willingness to f..."
entries.dialogueText: "As shown by their willingness to follow you into a foolish war that Sordland is ill-prepared to win."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""As shown by your leading the count..."
entries.dialogueText: "As shown by your leading the country into a foolish war that it is ill-prepared to win."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm going to crush Rumburg. Just l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to crush Rumburg. Just like I crushed you and the rest of the Old Guard."
entries.menuText: "I'm going to crush Rumburg. Just like I crushed you and the rest of the Old Guard."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They knew enough to vote me in. An..."
entries.dialogueText: "They knew enough to vote me in. And I knew enough to force you out."
entries.menuText: "They knew enough to vote me in. And I knew enough to force you out."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I knew enough to get rid of you an..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew enough to get rid of you and the rest of your Old Guard chums."
entries.menuText: "I knew enough to get rid of you and the rest of your Old Guard chums."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You're going to regret that. Sordl..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're going to regret that. Sordland without Sollism is a ship without a rudder."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And you think you would have done..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you think you would have done a better job?"
entries.menuText: "And you think you would have done a better job?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I would not have let our proud rep..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would not have let our proud republic stray so far from its Sollist roots."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Have you always been Soll's puppet..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you always been Soll's puppet? Or just since you entered my cabinet?"
entries.menuText: "Have you always been Soll's puppet? Or just since you entered my cabinet?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""To hell with Soll, and to hell wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "To hell with Soll, and to hell with you."
entries.menuText: "To hell with Soll, and to hell with you."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Mr. Rayne. Did you really take a h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Rayne. Did you really take a helicopter to Antel Rock just to provoke me?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""As I tried to tell you many times..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I tried to tell you many times when we were working together, Sordland is not United Contana. Your heedless shift towards Malenyevism will bring only chaos."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""As I tried to tell you many times..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I tried to tell you many times when we were working together, Sordland is not Arcasia. Your heedless shift towards liberalism will bring only chaos."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Your hapless attempts to reform th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your hapless attempts to reform the Constitution have gone against everything this country stands for."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas drew herself up, her back st..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas drew herself up, her back straight as a rod.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is that what you're writing? An ob..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that what you're writing? An obituary for your beloved Tarquin Soll?"
entries.menuText: "Is that what you're writing? An obituary for your beloved Tarquin Soll?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Including the decision to sacrific..."
entries.dialogueText: "Including the decision to sacrifice one man's life to save millions of Sordish people."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That decision wasn't yours to make.""
entries.dialogueText: "That decision wasn't yours to make."
entries.menuText: "That decision wasn't yours to make."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Save them from what, Lileas?""
entries.dialogueText: "Save them from what, Lileas?"
entries.menuText: "Save them from what, Lileas?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I thought you religious freaks wer..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you religious freaks were against playing God."
entries.menuText: "I thought you religious freaks were against playing God."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas' face darkened."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas' face darkened.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Oh, you'll see.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, you'll see."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I-- I suppose I did.""
entries.dialogueText: "I-- I suppose I did."
entries.menuText: "I-- I suppose I did."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Of course not. I just wanted to un..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course not. I just wanted to understand your motivations."
entries.menuText: "Of course not. I just wanted to understand your motivations."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is that who those letters are for?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that who those letters are for? Your beloved Tarquin Soll?"
entries.menuText: "Is that who those letters are for? Your beloved Tarquin Soll?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""History will redeem me. Even if yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "History will redeem me. Even if you won't."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""My motivations are and have always..."
entries.dialogueText: "My motivations are and have always been crystal clear. It's yours I would worry about."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Then allow me to return the favor.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then allow me to return the favor."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""All this change you've attempted t..."
entries.dialogueText: "All this change you've attempted to bring to Sordland... is it truly for the betterment of the country, or to cement a place for Anton Rayne in the history books?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You're hanging on by a thread, dea..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're hanging on by a thread, dear. Time is running out to choose how you want to be remembered."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""But as for you...""
entries.dialogueText: "But as for you..."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Sooner or later, the people will r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sooner or later, the people will realize that Soll was the best leader they'll ever have."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Guards! Take this woman's pens and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Guards! Take this woman's pens and paper away. They're too dangerous to have lying around."
entries.menuText: "Guards! Take this woman's pens and paper away. They're too dangerous to have lying around."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've had enough of this. I'm leavi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've had enough of this. I'm leaving."
entries.menuText: "I've had enough of this. I'm leaving."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards moved in and roughly gra..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards moved in and roughly grabbed Lileas' writing materials off her desk. She looked unfazed.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Thanks for the visit, Mr. Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for the visit, Mr. President. I'm sure this isn't the last we'll see of each other."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas nodded and turned back to he..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas nodded and turned back to her correspondence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards re-locked her cell door..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards re-locked her cell door and escorted me away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the way back to Holsord, I could..."
entries.dialogueText: On the way back to Holsord, I couldn't help thinking about what she said.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "How would I be remembered?"
entries.dialogueText: How would I be remembered?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Would I ever be able to escape Soll..."
entries.dialogueText: Would I ever be able to escape Soll's shadow?
